title: Totals per Name
statement: You get n lines. Each line has a name and an amount. The same name can appear many times. Add up the amounts for each name. Print each name with its total, one per line, as "name total". Sort the lines by name in ASCII order. In ASCII order, capital letters come before small letters. Print a name even if its total is 0.
inputFormat: First line: integer n. Then n lines, each with a name and an integer amount, separated by one space.
outputFormat: One line per different name, sorted by name in ASCII order: the name, a space, then the total.
constraints: Name has 1 to 10 English letters (A-Z, a-z); names are case-sensitive
Totals can be larger than 32-bit int
explanations: asha has 100+25=125, ravi has 50-20=30, meena has 70. Sorted by name: asha, meena, ravi.
zoya has 10+5=15 and amit has 20. After sorting, amit comes before zoya.

tests.input:
6
Zed 1
zed 2
Amy 3
amy 4
Zed 10
Amy -3
